cards.title: Why it works
items: Preflight refuses the lane before any change; a second, INDEPENDENT verifier node re-checks the prep it did not make
Complementary prune gates route drift and halt to echoes that terminate loud, so no silent half-release
Publication is audited per-channel: the fan-out runs each channel's OWN check, never a global pipeline status

cards.title: Contract
items: {{nodes}} nodes: preflight -> {{branches}}-way route -> prep -> verify -> approve -> publish -> await-ci -> per-channel fan-out -> closeout
Human gates carry the launch/answer surface; await-ci is a machine gate parking at no token cost at all
closeout joins every arm, live or pruned, from machine records auto-injected in ## Inputs
